statements.t: “Completing enrollment in HORIZON with more than 50 patients across three cohorts marks an important milestone for MZE829 and exceeded our target enrollment of 10-15 patients per cohort,” said Jason Coloma, Ph.D., chief executive officer of Maze.

We are encouraged by the previously reported clinically meaningful uACR reductions demonstrated among 12 efficacy-evaluable patients in an interim data cut from HORIZON, look forward to reporting the complete HORIZON dataset in early 2027, and plan to use these results to inform our pivotal program.

We are also making strong progress with MZE782 with respect to both continued enrollment in the Phase 2 CIPheR trial in PKU and advancement of our plans to initiate a Phase 2 CKD trial in the first half of 2027.”

dropped.t: “The second quarter was marked by continued operational excellence by our team, with the Phase 2 CIPheR trial of MZE782 in PKU now underway with initial topline data expected in 2027, and continued strong enrollment in the Phase 2 HORIZON trial of MZE829 across three cohorts with additional data on track for 10-15 patients per cohort in late 2026 or early 2027,” said Jason Coloma, Ph.D., chief executive officer…
We are also advancing MZE782 toward a Phase 2 trial in CKD, which we expect to initiate in the first half of next year.
With a strong balance sheet and expected cash runway into 2029, we are well positioned to execute against the clinical milestones in our pipeline.”
